_description: Bundled local subset of MITRE ATT&CK (Enterprise) techniques relevant to the demo scenario and common SOC alerts. Not a full copy of the framework — extend as needed. Fields loosely follow the public ATT&CK STIX schema.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to access credential material stored in LSASS process memory.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, or Defense Evasion.

techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
techniques.description: Adversaries may communicate using web protocols to blend in with existing traffic.

techniques.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
techniques.description: Adversaries may transfer tools or other files from an external system.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
techniques.description: Adversaries may achieve persistence by adding a program to a startup folder or referencing it with a Registry run key.

techniques.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, or otherwise obfuscating its contents.
